body:
This makes sense to me in principle. `RandomPCG` already supports the overload, and it's generally unsafe / unexpected to have automatic precision changes because we lack an overload of a fundamental function.

My main concern is that we have quite a lot of `randfn` boilerplate already, and I can't find a single caller of the existing `Math::randfn` version (except the exposed utility function, which always uses `double`). 

Going by https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12356, I suppose your main interest is the C# API? I'm not sure we should be making changes to core based on something that could be solved in C# as well, but I'm open to it if it's the best solution for C#. I suppose we'll need @godotengine/dotnet to comment on that.
